description: This Java source file defines the MonkeyPermissionUtil class, which manages runtime permission handling for the Android 'monkey' testing tool. It includes methods for selecting target packages, filtering permissions, populating permission mappings, and generating random permission events.

classes.name: MonkeyPermissionUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing runtime permissions in the Android monkey testing framework.

methods.name: MonkeyPermissionUtil
methods.description: Constructor initializing package and permission managers.

methods.name: setTargetSystemPackages
methods.description: Sets whether system packages should be targeted.

methods.name: shouldTargetPackage
methods.description: Determines if a package should be targeted based on filtering rules and system flags.

methods.name: shouldTargetPermission
methods.description: Checks if a permission should be targeted based on its group and flags.

methods.name: populatePermissionsMapping
methods.description: Populates the mapping of packages to their permissions for targeted packages.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the list of targeted packages and their permissions.

methods.name: generateRandomPermissionEvent
methods.description: Creates a random permission event for a targeted package.
